intro.text: The roughly four-thousand-year period after the Heraldic Epochs, which opened when mankind, told that the Voidbringers were beaten, began rebuilding after Aharietiam.

items.text: The Silver Kingdoms already existed before Aharietiam. The Knights Radiant upheld them as one realm linked through Urithiru, with Alethela at the heart of their defence.
Once the Knights fell and Urithiru was abandoned, each kingdom was cut off and could no longer work as it once had.
The era began after Aharietiam, the Last Desolation. Trusting the Heralds' word that the Voidbringers were beaten, mankind set about rebuilding.
The False Desolation: a war with singers who were not led by the Fused.
The Recreance, when the Knights Radiant broke their oaths and abandoned their Shards.
The Shin tried several times to conquer all of Roshar, and never succeeded.
The Hierocracy, when the Vorin church sought control over the world and history was heavily sanitized.
The Scouring of Aimia, a cataclysm of some kind that struck Aimia.
The assassination of Gavilar Kholin, king of Alethkar, on the Parshendi's behalf during the treaty celebration of 1167.
